name: ZAG
source:
ZAG is a short visual novel  about Teddy,  a new (half-demonic) student who's supposed to get a school tour. 

(Instead, he somehow ended up at the newspaper club - reading through newspaper clippings with the other members.)

[Edited from [url=https://kathinkapng.itch.io/zag]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
ZAG是一部关于泰迪的短篇视觉小说，泰迪是一名新生（半恶魔），他应该去学校参观。

（相反，他以某种方式最终进入了报刊俱乐部——与其他成员一起阅读剪报。）

[编辑自[url=https://kathinkapng.itch.io/zag]itch.io[/url]]
